content:
I had problems with getting them all aligned so i could get the screws in.
What I then did was to remove the heatbed again, use an allen key and push it through each expansion joint to align it with the screw below, then all screws were fitting like a charm.

hold up... I dont think this guide asked me to do this https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/4-heatbed-upgrade_1110680#1110920 by this point but thats a needed step to upgrade? So I am going to have to remove the heatbed again?

Use the alignment-tool for the heat-spacesrs if you do the Gen2- Upgrade!
Also you have to remove the offset sensor again in order to align the rigth corner spacer!

I don't really get the info point here regarding the Gen2 update:
Why shouldn't we fully tighten the screws here, and when should that be done? The Gen2-Heatbed update is complete by this step...

replies.content: Hello, thank you for the comment. The heatbed screws will be fully tightened in the later step because we still need to align the new expansion joints.
So to be clear... we will tighten the screws some time later AFTER this page, right?

Reading ahead, it seems like this is done a lot later, but you will eventually get to this step in the article and switch to the Gen 2 upgrade steps where you tighten these with the alignment tool.  Not sure why we don't do it now tho.  Comes after some belts stuff.
